name: ss-delphine-static-site
description: Validation tooling for the static SS Delphine charter presentation.

scripts.validate: npm run validate:html && npm run validate:css && npm run validate:js && npm run validate:data && node tests/site-check.mjs
scripts.validate:data: jq -e . site.webmanifest >/dev/null && xmllint --noout sitemap.xml && node tests/netlify-check.mjs
